title: 数字平方
problem_statement_md:
编写一个函数`square`，以一个数字为参数，并返回其**平方**。

你的程序从输入中获取数字，并将其传递给函数，函数应返回结果。

**main**函数已经包含了接收数字作为输入并调用**square**()函数的代码。

只需定义函数`square`即可！
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Square[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to create a function which takes a number as its argument and returns its [b]square[/b].

Your program needs to take the number from input and pass it to the function, which should return the result.
[note]The [b]main[/b] function already includes the code to take a number as input and call the [b]square[/b]() function. Complete the program by creating the function.[/note]

code_templates.template:
package main
import "fmt"

func main() {
	var x int
	fmt.Scanln(&x)

	res := square(x)
	fmt.Println(res)
}
